facts.text: Beginning in fall 2026, undergraduate students from North Carolina with family incomes under $200,000 per year will attend Wake Forest University tuition-free.

sources.title: Affordability | Undergraduate Admissions | Wake Forest University
sources.quote: Wake Forest University has announced that undergraduate students from North Carolina whose families make less than $200,000 per year will attend tuition-free, beginning in the fall of 2026.
